result.reason: The operative addition reaches the preferred position: up to six months of requested transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Company data in a commonly used machine-readable format within 30 days, and written certification of deletion thereafter. It is not fully minimal because it unnecessarily relocates the Confidential Information provision and expands the return obligation to all Works and Confidential Information, rather than limiting it to Customer/Company Data. Those changes do not materially alter the unrelated commercial intent, and the drafting is generally professional, though “Company data” should ideally be a defined term.
